description: A sine with separate pitch and amplitude envelopes, in the manner of the 808 toms

params.text: Sets the resting frequency of the sine within the range the L | M | H switch selects
Sets how fast the hit fades, 25ms to 100ms
Sets the range PITCH works over: L gives 80Hz to 280Hz, M gives 160Hz to 560Hz and H gives 320Hz to 1120Hz; the tooltip and the manual quote half these figures
Sets how fast the pitch envelope falls, 5ms to 50ms
Sets how far the pitch envelope lifts the sine at the start of a hit, up to 500Hz above the resting frequency
Fires the tom; a rising edge at the trigger jack does it too

inputs.text: A rising edge above 0.5V fires the sound; the length of the gate makes no difference
Adds to the AMP DECAY knob
Adds to the PITCH DECAY knob
Adds to the ENV DEPTH knob

notes: a CV input is bipolar and is added to its knob: 10V there is worth the knob's whole travel, -10V cancels a knob that is fully up, and the total is clamped to the knob's own range
a new module comes up with PITCH DECAY fully anticlockwise, at its shortest, so the initial bend is very quick

inputs.0:
high above 0.5V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
±10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
